ci._budget_note: Two numbers matter: the GitHub runner's and Google's. The runner (4x CPU slowdown on a shared 2-vCPU VM, benchmarkIndex ~2100-2500) scores this site 15-30 points below a developer laptop and below PageSpeed Insights. On 26 Sep 2026 it gave home 36 / LCP 7.5 s, calculator 49 / 4.8 s, pro 56 / 3.2 s, companies 52 / 4.0 s while a laptop gave 67 / 3.5 s, 52 / 7.0 s, 72 / 2.4 s, 65 / 3.6 s. The error floors here are regression guards for the runner (perf >= 0.3, LCP <= 8 s, CLS <= 0.1); the product targets remain mobile >= 80 and LCP <= 2.5 s as measured by PageSpeed Insights. Raise the floors after each verified gain; never lower them.
